title: Aubrey Plaza Net Worth 2025: How Much Money Does the Actress Make? - NewsBreak
text: Actress Aubrey Plaza has been active in the industry since the early 2000s. She has loved films and TV shows since she was a child and began her career with improv and sketch comedy. She served as an intern on Saturday Night Live before playing a minor role on 30 Rock. Her big break came in 2009 when she debuted as April Ludgate on Parks and Recreation. In the following years, Plaza has been equally active on both small and big screens. She is currently in the news after she opened up about the tragic death of her estranged husband, writer and director Jeff Baena. Accordingly, people are interested in her net worth and how much money she has made in 2025 . Plaza has a speculated net worth of $9 million in 2025. Plaza’s net worth in 2025 consists of earnings from her work as an actress. Plaza is most famous for essaying the role of April Ludgate on Parks and Recreation. She has also played memorable characters such as Julie Powers on Scott Pilgrim vs. the World, Cat Adams on Criminal Minds, Harper Spiller on The White Lotus, and Rio Vidal / Death on the MCU series Agatha All Along. Plaza is an actor. Most recently, she portrayed MG Falcone in Ethan Coen’s 2025 feature Honey Don’t!. Plaza earns money from acting and producing. Plaza has several projects in the pipeline. She will play Olga Acevedo on the drama series Olga Dies Dreaming. Plaza will also appear in John Waters’ crime feature Liarmouth: A Feel-Bad Romance, Zach Woods’ film The Accompanist, Leah Rachel’s biographical crime drama The Heidi Fleiss Story, and Peter Atencio’s action comedy Animal Friends. Additionally, Plaza is producing several of her upcoming projects, and they have likely contributed to her net worth.
